frontendRenderingIssue.description: MyBets leg click navigated to /sports?match=... but Sports.jsx only looked up live matches in local React state. When absent, it did not fetch /api/v1/matches/:id.

backendEventLookupIssue.description: API route /api/v1/matches/:id returned 404 if the match was not present in the ephemeral in-memory Map of that single Node process.

settlementEngineIssue.description: Uncaught RangeError: Invalid time value in evaluateSettlementConfidence when match.time='Live', crashing the settlement sweep.

separationAudit.verdict: Frontend visibility bug and Backend settlement crash were separate and have both been hardened.
